semiconductor_relevance: High — KLA Corporation is a leading supplier of process control and yield management solutions specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: KLA Corporation specializes in providing advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, and computational analytics that enhance process control and yield management in semiconductor manufacturing. Their solutions are integral to the production of integrated circuits and other nanoelectronics, supporting manufacturers from R&D through to high-volume production.
capabilities: Inline unpatterned and patterned wafer defect inspection
